verdict.rationale: Bitwarden ships an official MCP server (bitwarden/mcp-server) that completed a live stdio handshake, letting AI agents/assistants issue natural-language commands to manage the vault, backed by a full-featured CLI and llms.txt for AI-friendly docs. Missing for 10: no independent hands-on demonstration of a natural-language command actually retrieving/creating vault items via the MCP server, and community feedback flags CLI output risks (e.g., plaintext dumps) that complicate safe agentic use.
